issue_context.title: r114 or newer not working on iOS 9.x
issue_context.body:
Hi,

Since r114 nothing is displayed on the screen when running on iOS 9.x (iPad 2 or iPhone 4S), but with r113 or older works fine.
Example of non-working attached, replace the Threejs version by 110 for example and it works.

Is that intended or a bug?

Thank you!
